name: Fencing lessons
summary: How expats start fencing in Singapore — foil/epee/sabre intros, youth programmes, kit costs, and club vs commercial academy trade-offs.
body:
Fencing offers air-con sport with clear progression. Beginners usually start foil; epee and sabre follow. Kids’ classes and adult beginner courses run through clubs and private academies.

## What to budget
- Intro course fees before buying full kit
- Mask, jacket, glove, weapon rental vs purchase
- Electric lamé and body cords for weapon tracks
- Competition entry later (optional)
- Travel to limited specialised halls

Heat is less outdoor-brutal than running, but hydration still matters under masks.

## How to choose
Watch coach attention in group footwork drills. Prefer programmes that teach safety and referee basics early. Ask about weapon specialisation pressure on kids — early single-weapon lock-in is unnecessary for most. Trial before annual membership.

## Practical tip
Bring a water bottle and thin base layer; masks get swampy. Confirm left-handed kit availability before your child’s first weapon purchase.
